quirk: Q-01 POLRNW ADD 10000 to a YYYYMMDD expiry turns Feb 29 into the invalid date 20250229
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off): the new expiry is the old expiry plus one calendar year (LocalDate.plusYears), so Feb 29 renews to Feb 28. Every other renewal date is unchanged (POLRNW-L228/L231 still match).

quirk: Q-02 POLRNW counts open claims but never enforces the count, so a policy with 5 open claims renews
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off): more than pas.renewal.max-open-claims (default 3, the threshold in the POLRNW TODO) open claims makes the policy ineligible; the renewal is refused (422) and the policy is left as it was. Threshold pending PO/Claims confirmation.

quirk: Q-09 POLRNW sends the DB2 error text and then the renewal confirmation after a failed UPDATE
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off): renewal is one transaction; a failed write rolls back the policy, coverages, audit row and event and the caller gets an error, never a confirmation.

quirk: Q-14 POLEND continues after a failed ENDORSEMENTS insert: updates the premium, writes the audit queue and confirms
rationale: Fix (Proposed, pending PO sign-off): endorsement is one transaction; a failed insert rolls back the premium update, audit row and event and the caller gets an error, never a confirmation.
